nodes.name: Start — Draft Edition
nodes.notes: Click when you're ready to generate newsletter drafts. Should be run AFTER reviewing the research brief and adding any manual notes.

nodes.name: Notion — Latest Brief
nodes.notes: Gets the most recent research brief. REPLACE a6e3058578074fcc98e3dbdbfaf6f0d6.

nodes.name: Notion — Get Brief Content
nodes.notes: Fetches the block content of the research brief.

parameters.jsonBody:
={
  "model": "claude-sonnet-4-20250514",
  "max_tokens": 4096,
  "system": "You are the writer for 'The Prompt', an AI ecosystem intelligence newsletter. You produce THREE separate newsletter drafts from a research brief — one for each audience tier.

Style rules:
- Direct, no fluff, no motivational filler
- Evidence-based claims only
- Use pattern: Hook → Signal → Why it matters → What to do about it
- Each edition should be 400-600 words
- End each edition with a single actionable takeaway
- Include a 'CLAIMS CHECK' footnote for any unverified assertions

Output format (use these exact headers as delimiters):

---TIER1_EXEC_START---
Subject line: ...

[Newsletter body for non-technical executives]
---TIER1_EXEC_END---

---TIER2_TECH_START---
Subject line: ...

[Newsletter body for technical department heads]
---TIER2_TECH_END---

---TIER3_BUILDER_START---
Subject line: ...

[Newsletter body for AI practitioners and builders]
---TIER3_BUILDER_END---",
  "messages": [
    {
      "role": "user",
      "content": "Here is this week's research brief. Generate the three newsletter tier drafts:

{{ $json.briefText }}"
    }
  ]
}

nodes.name: Claude — Draft 3 Tiers
nodes.notes: Generates all 3 newsletter tiers from the research brief. 90s timeout for longer generation.

nodes.name: Notion — Save Each Tier
nodes.notes: Creates a Notion page for each tier draft. REPLACE a6e3058578074fcc98e3dbdbfaf6f0d6.
